name: browser-toolkit
description: Interactive visual browser testing, Playwright MCP/CLI/Test provider catalogs, debugging, and evidence capture.

interface.shortDescription: Interactively test and debug real browser workflows.
interface.longDescription: Attach to the owner's Chrome/Edge via Playwright Extension and Chrome DevTools autoConnect when the plugin is enabled. Prefer Playwright CLI for compact coding-agent capture; Playwright MCP for exploratory loops; Playwright Test for regressions. Do not persist these MCP servers in host config.
defaultPrompt: Interactively test this workflow and inspect the rendered UI.
Debug this browser failure using console and network evidence.
Check this page visually, semantically, and for accessibility.
